children: Beauce Gold Fields began sonic drilling in the Delery and Chaussegros sections of its Saint-Simon-les-Mines paleoplacer channel. The company plans approximately 20 holes, with additional holes dependent on ground conditions, productivity, saprolite thickness and drilling time.
This is an exploration update, not a resource result; the number of holes may change with field conditions.
Four additional holes planned in Chaussegros
Tests a section interpreted to include an ancient tributary, but no gold grades or assay results are reported.
More channel testing planned in 2027, subject to results and financing
Further exploration depends on outcomes and available funding, leaving the next phase uncertain.

This is an early-stage exploration update following the company's June 2026 technical assessment and conceptual Exploration Target. Assay results from the planned drilling and evidence supporting the target would be needed to make this a larger catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Beauce Gold Fields distributed by TheNewswire.
